summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Global X U.S. 500 ETF (GXLC) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the Solactive GBS United States 500 index. The fund tracks a market cap-weighted index comprised of US equity securities. The fund selects the largest securities by market cap. GXLC was launched on Sep 23, 2025 and is issued by Global X.

holdings.infoBox: GXLC is an equity ETF with a total of 500 individual holdings. The top holdings are NVIDIA stock at 7.91%, Apple at 7.13%, Microsoft at 5.81%, Alphabet at 5.67%, and Amazon.com at 3.74%.
